unit.why: A first-person memorate: on the morning of Shavuot the narrator walks in on his uncle and teacher, unseen, and hears him weeping in prayer to God; seized by trembling, he flees.

stories.start_quote: עוד שם פ"א כשהאיר היום בחג שבועות
stories.end_quote: וכעת ארבעים אלף בישראל אין די
stories.summary_en: On the dawn of Shavuot the narrator enters his holy uncle's room unnoticed and hears him pacing and weeping before God, begging not to be pushed away because of the crowd of 400-500 visitors that Samael may have sent; overcome with trembling, the narrator flees.
